On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# ARC template recoloring

1. Read the current input grid and identify its marker shape (the non-background, non-target-color cells); derive the template from this instance, not from a prior demo. Normalize its occupied coordinates to the top-left. Treat diagonally touching marker cells as one shape when needed.
2. Use the demonstrations to identify the candidate cells and recoloring rule. For the demonstrated pattern-copy task, find every translation of the current marker template whose cells are all target-color zeros, then recolor exactly those cells to the marker color. Do not rotate or reflect the template unless the examples establish that.
3. Validate by applying the same rule to a demo: compute the changed-cell set and check it equals the union of the matched template placements, with all other cells preserved. If it does not, revise the rule before submitting; request another demo only when needed to disambiguate.
4. Recheck output dimensions and every row against the input, preserving untouched cells. In the benchmark, end each response with exactly one valid action JSON object on the last line.
